warning[ZBX-W0205]: older output of the container was dropped
  while  reading the log of web-1
  cause  the log keeps at most 5 MiB; 16 bytes of older output were dropped
  name   web-1
  bytes  16
  fix    see the newest output only, without this note:   zbx logs --tail 100 <name>
  more   zbx explain W0205
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/W0205.html
